shortDescription: Manage IKE gateway on the firewall with subset of settings.

options.name: api_key
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The API key to use instead of generating it using I(username) / I(password).

options.name: commit
options.description: B(Deprecated) Please use M(paloaltonetworks.panos.panos_commit_firewall), M(paloaltonetworks.panos.panos_commit_panorama), M(paloaltonetworks.panos.panos_commit_push) instead. HORIZONTALLINE Commit changes after creating object.  If I(ip_address) is a Panorama device, and I(device_group) or I(template) are also set, perform a commit to Panorama and a commit-all to the device group/template.

options.name: dead_peer_detection_interval
options.description: Time in seconds to check for a dead peer.

options.name: dead_peer_detection_retry
options.description: Retry attempts before peer is marked dead.

options.name: enable_dead_peer_detection
options.description: True to enable Dead Peer Detection on the gateway.

options.name: enable_fragmentation
options.description: True to enable IKE fragmentation Incompatible with pre-shared keys, or 'aggressive' exchange mode

options.name: enable_liveness_check
options.description: Enable sending empty information liveness check message.

options.name: enable_nat_traversal
options.description: True to NAT Traversal mode

options.name: enable_passive_mode
options.description: True to have the firewall only respond to IKE connections and never initiate them.

options.name: gathered_filter
options.description: When I(state=gathered). An advanced filtering option to filter results returned from PAN-OS. Refer to the guide discussing I(gathered_filter) for more information.

options.name: ikev1_crypto_profile
options.description: Crypto profile for IKEv1.

options.name: ikev1_exchange_mode
options.description: The IKE exchange mode to use

options.name: ikev2_crypto_profile
options.description: Crypto profile for IKEv2.

options.name: interface
options.description: Specify the outgoing firewall interface to the VPN tunnel.

options.name: ip_address
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The IP address or hostname of the PAN-OS device being configured.

options.name: liveness_check_interval
options.description: Delay interval before sending probing packets (in seconds).

options.name: local_id_type
options.description: Define the format of the identification of the local gateway. ipaddr: IP address fqdn: FQDN (hostname) ufqdn: User FQDN (email address) keyid: Key ID (binary format ID string in hex)

options.name: local_id_value
options.description: Define the value for the identification of the local gateway. Required when I(local_id_type) is set.

options.name: local_ip_address
options.description: Bind IKE gateway to the specified interface IP address.  Only needed if 'interface' has multiple IP addresses associated with it. It should include the mask, such as '192.168.1.1/24'

options.name: local_ip_address_type
options.description: The type of the bound interface IP address. ip: Specify exact IP address if interface has multiple addresses. floating-ip: Floating IP address in HA Active-Active configuration. Required when 'local_ip_address' is set.

options.name: name
options.description: Name for the profile.

options.name: password
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The password to use for authentication.  This is ignored if I(api_key) is specified.

options.name: peer_id_check
options.description: Type of checking to do on peer_id.

options.name: peer_id_type
options.description: Define the format of the identification of the peer gateway. ipaddr: IP address fqdn: FQDN (hostname) ufqdn: User FQDN (email address) keyid: Key ID (binary format ID string in hex)

options.name: peer_id_value
options.description: Define the value for the identification of the peer gateway. Required when I(peer_id_type) is set.

options.name: peer_ip_type
options.description: IP or dynamic.

options.name: peer_ip_value
options.description: IPv4 address of the peer gateway.

options.name: port
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The port number to connect to the PAN-OS device on.

options.name: pre_shared_key
options.description: Specify pre-shared key.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: state
options.description: The state.

options.name: template
options.description: (Panorama only) The template this operation should target. Mutually exclusive with I(template_stack).

options.name: template_stack
options.description: (Panorama only) The template stack this operation should target. Mutually exclusive with I(template).

options.name: username
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The username to use for authentication.  This is ignored if I(api_key) is specified.

options.name: version
options.description: Specify the priority for Diffie-Hellman (DH) groups.
